## Part 1

### Question 1

This is the R Markdown template that should be used for assignment 1. Remember
to provide explanations in text as is done here, and supply comments in the R
code. All code should go into code chunks like the one below. It is highly
recommended that you knit the document to HTML before submitting, to make sure
that it works and gives the correct results to each question.

```{r Q1 code}
setwd("C:/Users/tijja/Documents/R programming/Rsubread")
library(Rsubread)
library(limma)
library(DESeq2)
options(digits=2)
list.files("C:/Users/tijja/Documents/R programming/Rsubread")
targets <- readTargets(file="target.txt")
targets
dir.create("index")
dir.create("BAM")
buildindex(basename="index/chrX_melanogaster",reference="DM_chrX.fa.gz",gappedIndex = TRUE) 
align(index="index/chrX_melanogaster",readfile1=targets$InputFile,input_format="FASTQ",output_format="BAM",output_file=targets$OutputFile,sortReadsByCoordinates=TRUE)
propmapped(targets$OutputFile)
subjunc(index="index/chrX_melanogaster",readfile1=targets$InputFile,input_format="FASTQ",output_format="BAM",output_file=targets$OutputFile,
sortReadsByCoordinates=TRUE)
propmapped(targets$OutputFile)
fc <- featureCounts(files=targets$OutputFile,annot.ext="DM_chr.gtf.gz",
isGTFAnnotationFile=TRUE)
count2=fc$counts # Extract the counts 
head(count2) # Print only the first 6 columns 
anot=fc$annotation
head(anot)
count3=data.frame(anot$Length,count2)
colnames(count3)=c("width","Sample1","Sample2","Sample3","Sample4","Sample5",
"Sample6", "Sample7") 
head(count3, 7)
counts=count3[rowSums(count3[,-1])>=10,][,-1] 
dim(counts)
write.table(counts,"counts.csv")
countsF=read.table("counts.csv")
counts
top <- counts[order(rowSums(counts), decreasing = TRUE), ]
genes <- rownames(top)[1:7]
genes
counts[genes, ]
```

### Question 2



```{r Q2 code}
library(DESeq2)
treat=factor(c("KO","WT","WT","KO","KO","KO","KO"),levels=c("WT","KO"))
sampleinfo=data.frame(sampleName=colnames(counts),group=treat)
sampleinfo                      # check each sample has the right group
ddsMat <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts,colData = sampleinfo,design = ~ group)
dds2 <- DESeq(ddsMat)
sizeFactors(dds2)               # normalization factors, for the slide
res <- results(dds2)
summary(res)
DEGs=data.frame(res[which(res$padj<0.05),])
print(DEGs,digits=2)
sampleinfo
```

## Part 2

### Question 4



```{r Q4 code}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(clustree)
library(ggplot2)
list.files()
pbmc = readRDS("sc_dataset1.rds")
pbmc
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.3)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)
FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = c("CD19", "CD3E", "CD14"))
```



```{r Q7 code, fig.align='center', out.width='768'}
new.ids <- c("0: T cells", "1: T cells", "2: Monocytes", "3: B cells")
names(new.ids) <- levels(pbmc)
pbmc <- RenameIdents(pbmc, new.ids)
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 5, repel = TRUE) + NoLegend()
```
